title: Registry Recognition — payload
description: TRQP v2.0 recognition query: ask a trust registry whether an entity is recognised by an authority for a given action+resource, evaluated as of `context.time` (or the registry's current time) against the matching record's validity window. Members are lowerCamelCase per the registry naming convention; a registry serving the plain HTTP TRQP binding maps them to TRQP's snake_case field names (`entityId` ↔ `entity_id`, `evaluatedAt` ↔ `time_evaluated`, and so on) at that binding.

entityId.description: Identifier of the entity being tested for recognition.

authorityId.description: Identifier of the authority being queried to recognise the entity.

action.description: The action the query is checking recognition for.

resource.description: The resource the query is checking recognition for.

recognized.description: True if the action+resource has been recognised, false otherwise.

evaluatedAt.description: Server time the query was evaluated at, per the endpoint clock.

asOf.description: The requested server time, echoed from the request `context.time` when supplied.

message.description: Additional human-readable detail about the recognition response.
